original.code: 1#include <AccelStepper.h>2 3const int STEPS = 2048;    // one turn of a 28BYJ-484const int SEGMENTS = 8;    // 256 steps each5const int BUTTON = 2;6// four wires, full steps: pins IN1, IN3, IN2, IN47AccelStepper wheel(AccelStepper::FULL4WIRE, 8, 10, 9, 11);8 9const char* PRIZES[] = {"50", "100", "200", "AGAIN",10                        "500", "x2", "1000", "JACKPOT"};11int at = 0;  // the segment under the pointer12 13void setup() {14  pinMode(BUTTON, INPUT);15  wheel.setMaxSpeed(24 * STEPS / 60.0);  // steps a second16  wheel.setAcceleration(1200);17  Serial.begin(9600);18  randomSeed(analogRead(A0));19}20 21void loop() {22  if (digitalRead(BUTTON) == HIGH) {23    int prize = random(SEGMENTS);24    int ahead = (prize - at + SEGMENTS) % SEGMENTS;25    long steps = (1 * SEGMENTS + ahead) * (STEPS / SEGMENTS);26    wheel.move(steps);27    wheel.runToPosition();  // speed up, spin, slow down onto it28    at = prize;29    Serial.print("Landed on ");30    Serial.println(PRIZES[at]);31  }32}

original.code: 1#include <Servo.h>2 3const int FSR = A0;4const int BELL = 8;5const long PULLDOWN = 10000;  // ohms, from A0 to GND6Servo needle;7 8int best = 0;              // the hardest press lately9unsigned long bestAt = 0;  // when it happened10bool rung = false;11 12void setup() {13  needle.attach(9);14  Serial.begin(9600);15}16 17void loop() {18  int force = analogRead(FSR);  // higher the harder you press19 20  // a harder press takes over; after a while the needle lets go21  if (force >= best || millis() - bestAt > 1500) {22    best = force;23    bestAt = millis();24  }25  needle.write(map(best, 0, 1023, 0, 180));26 27  if (best > 880 && !rung) {28    tone(BELL, 1568, 400);  // ding!29    rung = true;30  } else if (best < 880 - 100) {31    rung = false;32  }33 34  if (force > 10) {35    // the sensor's resistance, worked out from the divider36    long ohms = PULLDOWN * (L - force) / force;37    Serial.print(force);38    Serial.print("  ");39    Serial.print(ohms);40    Serial.println(" ohms");41  }42  delay(20);43}
